recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular tondo featuring an Art Nouveau-style profile of a woman with flowing golden hair and ornate jewelry, set against a deep navy blue void with stacked psychedelic typography above.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular illustration centered in a square dark field
Warm gold and ochre tones contrasting with cool navy background
Intricate decorative patterns within the circle versus minimalist negative space outside
Stacked text hierarchy following a top-center alignment
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The circular illustration occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face in profile, specifically the eye and the large circular earring/headpiece.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top typography, moves down to the circular frame, follows the curve of the hair downward, then circles back through the ornate headpiece.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid navy blue space surrounds the central elements, creating a focused, iconic feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright subject and dark background; muted saturation within the illustration to mimic aged lithography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to a single dark tone

letterConstructionRules: Liquid, melting baselines for the middle word
Sharp, calligraphic flourishes for the top and bottom words
Thick black outlines with inner color fills
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have bulbous, bottom-heavy proportions
Ascenders and descenders in secondary text extend into long, sharp horizontal whips
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, heavy psychedelic lettering and sharp, thin calligraphic scripts.
graphicDevices: Circular border with geometric mosaic pattern
Flowing hair that breaks the circular frame at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic weight and curves
Matches the historical aesthetic of the illustration

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central circular illustration in the style of Alphonse Mucha featuring a woman in profile with long golden hair and ornate jewelry. Place this circle on a solid, dark navy blue square background. Ensure the hair spills slightly out of the bottom of the circle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom vector lettering above the circle. The middle word should be large, orange-gold, and psychedelic. The top and bottom words should be in a white, sharp, calligraphic script with long horizontal flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the illustration contained within a tondo?
Is the background a solid dark navy?
Does the hair break the circular frame at the bottom?
Is the typography stacked and centered?

adjustableVariables: The specific shade of the navy background
The degree of 'melt' in the psychedelic lettering
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, thick black outlines on the figure
Ensure the text is legible despite the psychedelic distortion
Verify the circular frame has an internal decorative pattern
Confirm the background is a flat, dark color without noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Art Nouveau Tondo + Psychedelic Typography + Dark Void Background
